title: Illustrative local GPU energy estimate
description: A published 8B-class GPU benchmark is applied to output tokens for local 7B–10B model tags as a sensitivity only.
plainLanguageSummary: This is a small GPU-only sensitivity for the 9B-class local workload, transferred from a published 8B H100 benchmark. The 27B workload is left unestimated because this source setup does not provide a compatible reference.
howToRead: The three lines apply half, the published reference, and twice the reference GPU energy per generated output token. The estimate is not whole-system electricity and is not a power reading from the local machine.

calculation.formula: Output tokens × GPU joules per output token ÷ 3,600 = GPU Wh; low/reference/high use 0.5×/1×/2× the benchmark reference.
calculation.explanation: The reference is 0.1467 GPU J/output token for Llama 3.1 8B, vLLM, batch 128, four H100 GPUs. It is not local telemetry and does not estimate prompt processing, CPU, memory, remaining node loads, or cooling.
calculation.example: A value at date t uses only observations dated t or earlier unless the chart explicitly labels a visual shift.

patternsToWatch: How much the estimated energy range widens under the sensitivity multipliers
limitations: A different model, device, engine, quantization, context length, and batch size can change energy per token.
Prompt processing and all non-GPU energy are excluded, so this is not full inference electricity.
No corresponding value is estimated for the local 27B model tag.
sourceNotes: TokenPowerBench paper and authors' released result files

methodology.formula: Output tokens × GPU joules per output token ÷ 3,600 = GPU Wh; low/reference/high use 0.5×/1×/2× the benchmark reference.
methodology.notes: The reference is 0.1467 GPU J/output token for Llama 3.1 8B, vLLM, batch 128, four H100 GPUs. It is not local telemetry and does not estimate prompt processing, CPU, memory, remaining node loads, or cooling.
